latestTerminalSummary:
Completed the assigned critic stage and completed the single native Goal. Its exact activation and completion responses are preserved in [native-goal-receipts.json](ER12_RUNTIME/runs/A8-02/control/stages/critic/native-goal-receipts.json).

The [critique](ER12_RUNTIME/runs/A8-02/control/stages/critic/critique.md) found no material factual errors. It records a localized route-comparison gap, a device-level claim that needs qualification, and a freshness-indicator clarification. The [source map](ER12_RUNTIME/runs/A8-02/control/stages/critic/source-map.json) and [source index](ER12_RUNTIME/runs/A8-02/control/stages/critic/sources/index.md) contain 15 independently checked sources. Primary-source checks confirmed the TTS MQTT QoS restriction and its protocol meaning ([TTS](https://www.thethingsindustries.com/docs/integrations/other-integrations/mqtt/), [OASIS](https://docs.oasis-open.org/mqtt/mqtt/v3.1.1/os/mqtt-v3.1.1-os.html)) and the Beam 2.69.0 fix listing ([release notes](https://github.com/apache/beam/releases/tag/v2.69.0)).

No product validation was run; proposed checks remain proposed.
